["Garden is a trustless Bitcoin bridge that enables fast, non-custodial swaps between BTC and other chains. It allows you to move native BTC into other networks without relying on custodians, wrapped assets, or centralized bridges, making Bitcoin liquidity more accessible while preserving its core security assumptions.

The project is built by the team behind renBTC, with nearly a decade of experience designing and operating infrastructure that has moved billions in Bitcoin across chains. data.name: Tator Trader
data.description: AI-powered conversational trading agent across Telegram, WhatsApp, X, and web. Trade on 20+ chains through natural language.
data.description_detail:
["Tator Trader is a conversational AI trading agent that lets users trade crypto through natural language across Telegram, WhatsApp, X (Twitter), Web, and native iOS/Android apps. Instead of navigating complex DEX interfaces, users simply say what they want to do: "swap 0.1 ETH for USDC" or "show me the best yields on stablecoins" — and Tator handles the rest.

Built with security-first architecture, Tator uses MPC wallets where the AI never has access to private keys. The AI parses user intent, deterministic code builds the transaction, and the user confirms every execution via slide-to-confirm. No secrets in context, nothing to leak.

Core capabilities include token swapping across 20+ blockchains, real-time portfolio tracking with PnL, yield farming with live APY data from protocols like Morpho, Aave, and Compound, prediction markets integration across multiple providers, and built-in token security scanning powered by Quick Intel.

Tator is designed to reduce cognitive load for traders while maintaining full user control over funds. Whether you're a power user managing positions across chains or a newcomer making your first swap, the conversational interface meets you where you are — in the messaging apps you already use.

The platform has been live on MegaETH since December 2025, with the same security model and feature set available across all supported chains and platforms. Tator is built and operated by Quick Intel, a crypto security company with deep expertise in smart contract analysis and blockchain infrastructure across 60+ chains."]

data.name: SIR Trading

data.description_detail: ["Most leverage is built for adrenaline, not conviction. You either bleed from funding/borrow rates, get liquidated, or watch your position quietly decay. When liquidity is deep, SIR can deliver accelerating returns that behave the way people intuitively expect leverage to behave. data.description_detail: ["Across helps you move money where you need it, when you need it. Bridge and swap tokens across chains in seconds with negligible fees. Supported chains include Ethereum, MegaETH, Solana, BNB Smart Chain, Base, Arbitrum, and many more."]

data.name: Lora Finance
data.description: The First Renting Upside Protocol.
data.description_detail: ["Lora Finance is an innovative MegaETH-native DeFi protocol that enables users to maintain price exposure to their preferred assets with high capital efficiency and zero liquidation risk. This is achieved by renting convexity through a Superfluid-powered payment stream, eliminating the fragility of traditional leveraged positions."]

data.name: OFFSHORE PROTOCOL
data.description: Earn USDm in this idle money laundering simulator. Build the optimal loadout of a criminal network - involving risky trades, assets, and relationships. Presale live on day 1 of MegaETH.
data.description_detail: ["OFFSHORE EMPIRE is an idle money laundering simulator where you build a global criminal network. \nInvest USDM in offshore shell companies that generate $DIRTY cash through risky leveraged trades. Use that cash to acquire assets and relationships - each with unique stats for Laundering Rate, Efficiency, Discretion, and more. Your loadout determines how much USDC you earn from automated 8-hour laundering cycles. Balance aggressive returns against suspicion management - push too hard and authorities shut you down. \nStrategic loadout building meets idle gameplay with real risk/reward from failed illegal operations."]

data.name: Nectar AI
data.description: Nectar AI is a decentralized platform focused on AI storytelling, companions, and fan fiction highlighting the capabilities of onchain AI agents.
data.description_detail: ["Nectar is a decentralized AI platform that allows users to create AI companions as well as roleplay with them. Users can create unique fictional storylines with AI that is able to respond back with text, image, video, or voice. A strong degree of multimodality allows for intelligent characters that feel personal, persistent, and alive.","Unlike traditional AI chat apps, companions on Nectar will also have onchain AI capabilities; their action space includes the ability to understand your preferences from memory and act on them, using MegaETH as the substrate for agentic action. Creators can leverage this to unlock new ways to build audiences, monetize, and experiment with decentralized distribution models.","Furthermore, the Love Island game highlights the capability to have multi agent simulations on a realtime blockchain. Each agent is a popular character created on Nectar and then placed in a unique multiplayer storyline to interact with.","Under the hood, Nectar is powered by a powerful orchestration infrastructure designed to combine real-time AI systems, modular services, and crypto-friendly primitives allowing for robust creator economies, and interactive AI worlds. Using Nectar offers a glimpse into how AI and blockchain can converge to create entirely new forms of expression and connection. In the future, Nectar's infrastructural technology will be made available to allow anyone to spawn new AI powered apps."]

data.name: Supernova
data.description: Trade and hedge a new onchain asset class of interest, FX and cross-crypto rates - all enabled by real-time execution on an orderbook. Currently invite-only.
data.description_detail: ["Supernova enables on-chain trading and hedging of interest rates, crypto cross-rates, and FX at millisecond latency. While assets are natively tradable on-chain, their rates—borrow costs, cross-asset spreads, and FX differentials—remain largely untradable. Supernova is the first on-chain rate exchange to unlock this primitive. Usecases includes:","1. Fixed-rate borrowing for institutions and looping strategies: Borrow at fixed rates directly from protocols such as Aave, eliminating exposure to floating-rate volatility.","2. Macro rate trading: Express directional views by trading or shorting DeFi interest rates, such as Aave borrow and supply curves.","3. Crypto cross-rate trading: Pair trade BTC/ETH and other crypto cross-rates using USDC margin, without holding or settling the underlying assets or managing dual-margin.","4. Programmable FX for stablecoin accounts: Enable any stablecoin account to become a multi-currency account with a single API call, providing synthetic FX rate exposure without moving or converting funds."]

data.name: Cap
data.description: Cap is a stablecoin protocol that generates yield through covered credit and is backstopped by onchain financial guarantees.
data.description_detail: ["Cap is a stablecoin protocol that is generates yield through covered credit and is backstopped by onchain financial guarantees. At its core, Cap is powered by a three-sided marketplace; users who deposit payments stablecoins and tokenized MMFs in return for cUSD, operators (market makers, trading shops, etc.) who borrow the assets backing cUSD, and delegators (restakers) who underwrite operator activities with ETH, BTC, and other high opportunity cost assets. Investors and ecosystem participants that make up Cap include Benjamin Franklin, Susquehanna Crypto, Flow Traders, IMC Trading, EtherFi, and others."]

data.name: Brix
data.description: Access yield from Emerging Markets, starting with the Turkish Lira - enabled by DeFi Legos (tokenized MMFs, custodied real-world assets and staking).
data.description_detail: ["DeFi yield is notorious for one thing: it always runs out. Meanwhile, emerging markets generate hundreds of billions in real, scalable sovereign yield; but access is locked behind big banks, FX desks, and regulatory walls. Brix partners directly with the largest banks to bring these EM assets onchain for the first time via a new generation of stablecoin assets.","What this unlocks is massive: global liquidity in DeFi that actually yields, and yield that can be accessed by anyone who wants it. ","The first stablecoin available on Brix is iTRY, a Turkish Lira pegged stablecoin backed by tokenized money-market funds. It currently delivers up to ~40% yield, coming to DeFi."]

Vaults can be curated by top-performing DLMM bots, AI agents, or human strategists."]

data.name: Transak
data.description: Leading Payments Infrastructure for Stablecoins and Cryptocurrencies
data.description_detail: ["Transak is the payments infrastructure for stablecoins and crypto. With its Virtual Account APIs and compliance-ready rails, Transak enables apps to onboard users, facilitate cross-border payments, and support multi-party payment flows—natively within their platforms.","Integrated by 450+ apps and used by 10 million+ users globally, Transak powers fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-fiat transactions through bank transfers, cards, local payment methods, and stablecoins.","Transak operates globally with offices in Miami, London, Bengaluru, Dubai, and Hong Kong."]

data.name: Premarket
data.description: Pre-listing price discovery on anything. Trade FDV bands to express conviction before tokens list. An app by Stryke.
data.description_detail: ["Premarket by Stryke is the missing infrastructure layer for pre-listing price discovery. Instead of accepting valuations set by insiders and market makers, traders can express conviction through FDV band markets: structured contracts that pay based on where a token actually lists. Teams outsource valuation discovery to the market, gaining transparent consensus before TGE while immunizing against FDV criticism. The result is quantifiable belief curves that replace speculation with structured, verifiable data, capturing the price formation window that currently doesn't exist in crypto or private equity."]

data.name: Huntertales
data.description: Idle, onchain GameFi where you recruit Hunters and push forward with others in a shared persistent campaign against the Dark Continent.
data.description_detail: ["Huntertales is an idle, onchain GameFi built around a massive shared, persistent campaign and war against the Dark Continent. You recruit Hunters by burning $CROWN, and the community simultaneously deploys them to push for absolute control of the continent. Your Hunters earn passive rewards based on deployment time, depth, and sector state while facing dynamic death every war epoch. If your Hunter survives and the sector or event completes, you claim your proportional sector bounty share. If your Hunter dies, you recruit again. The cycle repeats. "]
